summary:
Frontend-only validation of (1) plantilla DELETE in /projects TemplatesAdminDialog and (2) Vista Previa using email-render class. ALL 4 features in the request PASS end-to-end. Default seed template 'project_notify_bank' AND custom template 'tpl_1780977753096' (Avance de Proyecto) were both successfully deleted via the trash button, returned HTTP 200, displayed toast 'Plantilla eliminada', disappeared from the list, and did NOT reappear after a hard refresh (tombstone persisted). Vista Previa opens via project-tpl-editor-preview-btn, the body has data-testid project-tpl-editor-preview-body and uses the 'email-render' class (no 'prose'). Computed styles confirm font-size:14px, line-height:21px (1.5), font-family Arial/Helvetica, and every

has margin '0px 0px 10px' — matching the new normalize_email_html spec so the on-screen preview is compact and uniform.

design_issues.screen: Global app shell (pre-existing, unrelated to this change)
issues: Persistent hydration console errors '<tr> cannot be a child of <span>' / '<span> cannot be a child of <tbody>' (carried from iterations 53–55, NOT regressed).

preview_email_render.result: PASS — preview body uses email-render with the compact paragraph spacing (margin 0 0 10px, line-height 1.5)

critical_code_review_comments: delete_email_template fix (tombstone for default templates) works end-to-end via UI: default + custom deletions both return 200, list refresh excludes them, and the exclusion persists across full page reloads.

RichTextEditor preview body correctly migrated from 'prose prose-sm' to 'email-render'. Computed paragraph margin (0 0 10px) and container line-height (1.5) match the new normalize_email_html injection, so on-screen preview is now consistent with what Gmail will render (assuming send_email applies normalize_email_html).
NOTE (out of automated scope): the actual Gmail rendering cannot be verified without sending a real email; only the in-app preview was validated as required by the request.
seed_data_creation: None directly created. However, the test DELETED two real templates: (a) the default seed 'project_notify_bank' (now tombstoned — can be restored via reset endpoint if needed) and (b) the custom 'tpl_1780977753096' Avance de Proyecto. Main agent may want to restore them in the preview env if they were needed for other tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Project templates dialog: open via [data-testid='projects-templates-btn'] → [data-testid='templates-dialog']. Each row exposes [data-testid='template-item-{id}'], [data-testid='edit-template-{id}'], [data-testid='delete-template-{id}']. The delete button triggers window.confirm — Playwright must register page.on('dialog', d.accept()). DELETE always returns 200 now (default templates included) thanks to the tombstone fallback. Preview button: [data-testid='project-tpl-editor-preview-btn']; preview body: [data-testid='project-tpl-editor-preview-body'] with class 'email-render'. Two templates were removed during testing: project_notify_bank (default) and tpl_1780977753096 (custom Avance de Proyecto). Remaining templates after this run: project_notify_client, c, asig_proyec_integ, tpl_1781119469284, new_integration_project, project_notify_bank_client.
rca of the issue: N/A — the two reported bugs are FIXED. (1) Plantilla DELETE works for both default (project_notify_bank) and custom (tpl_*) templates via tombstone logic. (2) Vista Previa now uses .email-render giving compact paragraph spacing (margin 0 0 10px, line-height 1.5) matching the email normalize_email_html output.
